one_line: Help desk and shared-inbox platform with a Mailbox API (v2 current) covering conversations, customers, mailboxes, reports, workflows, and webhooks.
auth_notes: API keys passed via HTTP Basic auth (API key as username) for API 2.0; OAuth2 also supported for user-scoped access.
self_serve_notes: Paid plans only; API keys generated in account settings. No free tier, but no sales gate.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Conversations, threads, customers, mailboxes, folders, tags, teams, users, workflows, and extensive reports endpoints; 100+ endpoints.
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhooks supported (create webhook endpoint; conversation event notifications).

existing_mcp.note: No official MCP server found; community servers unverified.

evidence.note: Fetched text (018_help_scout.txt) is the Mailbox API docs: API-key auth, endpoint list, webhooks, rate limits.

agent_notes: Fetched page was legacy v1 docs; v2 noted as current. OAuth2 support inferred from knowledge.
